about: C-004: one plain request per setting of the Mapbox Standard style (schema as served on 2026-11-25, 48 settings). A request says what a person wants, never the setting's name. `expect` is how evals/config/grade.mjs decides: bool and enum values must match exactly; a colour must come out as the hex given (after the browser normalises it); `min` and `max` bound a number; `includes` is a substring the value must contain.

I have a colour look-up table (LUT) image, encoded as base64, that should recolour the whole basemap. Apply it; write the placeholder string LUT_BASE64 where the data goes.
